name: Klap
description_en:
Klap repurposes existing long videos into short clips with captions, reframing and optional social publishing. It also exposes APIs for automated clipping and editing. Its homepage says speech-rich material such as interviews, podcasts and training works best because selection relies heavily on speech detection.

It is primarily an editing and repurposing workflow, not a guarantee of viral reach or a text-to-video generator that replaces source footage. Judge the selected moments and final framing against the original video before publishing.
description_zh:
Klap 将已有长视频转为短片，提供字幕、重构图及可选社交发布，也开放自动剪辑和编辑API。首页说明访谈、播客、培训等语音丰富素材更适合，因为片段选择较依赖语音检测。

它主要用于编辑和再利用，不保证传播效果，也不是替代原素材的文本生成视频工具。发布前应按原视频核对所选片段和最终构图。

sections.title_en: Review meaning as well as framing
sections.en:
The web workflow accepts a YouTube link or uploaded file, generates candidate clips, allows branding/framing adjustments and exports or schedules results. AI reframing and captions are useful starting points, but a clip can omit a qualification or crop the subject needed to understand a demonstration. A virality score is an algorithmic estimate, not measured audience response.

For an evaluation, use a short owned interview with two speakers, inspect a proposed excerpt against the surrounding dialogue and correct names, numbers and caption timing. Verify that screen content remains readable in the selected aspect ratio. No upload, render, transcription or publishing action was executed here.
sections.zh:
网页流程接收YouTube链接或上传文件，生成候选片段，可调整品牌／构图，再导出或排期。AI构图和字幕是起点，但片段可能省略限定条件，或裁掉理解演示所需主体。传播评分是算法估计，不是实测观众反应。

评估可用自有双人短访谈，将候选片段与前后对话对照，更正名称、数字和字幕时序，并核对目标比例下屏幕内容可读。本文未上传、渲染、转录或发布。

sections.title_en: Processing completion is not export completion
sections.title_zh: 处理完成不等于导出完成
sections.en:
The API guide separates creating a video-to-shorts task, polling its status, listing projects in the output folder, selecting a clip and creating a separate export job. Both processing and export can end in error; the final export returns a video URL. Keep the task and export identifiers when handling a failure rather than assuming a returned project is already a downloadable final file.

The introduction documents API-key authentication and a separate OAuth API acting on a user’s subscription. The generation guide supports YouTube and direct video-file URLs, while Google Drive/Twitch are marked future additions. Its complete example uses an api.klap.video base URL while the introduction uses api.klap.app; confirm the supported endpoint before implementing. No API call was made.
sections.zh:
API指南区分创建video-to-shorts任务、轮询状态、列输出文件夹项目、选片段及另建导出任务。处理和导出均可报错，最终导出返回视频URL。失败处理应保留任务及导出标识，不能将已返回项目视为已可下载最终文件。

介绍说明API key认证及另一个代表用户订阅执行的OAuth API。生成指南支持YouTube和直接视频文件URL，Google Drive／Twitch标为未来增加。完整示例用api.klap.video，而介绍用api.klap.app，实施前需确认支持端点。本文未调用API。

sections.title_en: Clip quotas and API billing need their own check
sections.title_zh: 片段配额及API计费需分别核对
sections.en:
The current pricing page lists Basic USD14/month billed yearly for100 clips/month, Pro39 for300 and Pro+94 for1000. It includes AI clipping, social accounts and analytics. The homepage’s older-looking FAQ still says Pro29/month; that conflict means checkout and renewal should be confirmed rather than mixing the figures. The homepage offers one free trial video, not a verified unlimited free tier.

API-key service pricing and OAuth subscription charging are different integration paths. This reading did not establish whether every export, retry or regenerated clip counts toward the displayed web quota. Content rights, social-account permissions, storage retention and commercial license details were not reviewed.
sections.zh:
当前价格页列Basic按年付月均14美元、每月100片段，Pro39／300，Pro+94／1000，含AI剪辑、社交账户及分析。首页看似较旧的FAQ仍称Pro每月29，存在冲突，需核结账和续费，不能混用数字。首页提供一次免费视频试用，不是已核无限免费版。

API key服务价格与OAuth订阅扣费是不同集成路径。本文未确认每次导出、重试或重新生成是否占网页配额，未核内容权益、社交账户权限、存储保留及商业许可细节。
